strings.name: S. Jaishankar
strings.summary: Jaishankar moved from career diplomacy into cabinet politics. After postings in Singapore, China and the United States, he became foreign secretary in 2015 and minister in 2019. Reappointed in 2024, he continued multilateral and security diplomacy, meeting his French and Emirati counterparts in September 2026.
